properties.question: When you say "this issue is fine, I've looked at it", that sign-off currently keeps holding even after the thing you looked at has been reworded underneath you — so it can end up defending something you never actually read. Should we build it so your sign-off expires when the wording changes, put that off, or leave it as it is?
